answer: Based on FY2022 data, 3M operates a moderately capital-intensive business. In FY2022, 3M reported capital expenditures (payments to acquire property, plant, and equipment) of $1,749 million against total revenues of $34,229 million, resulting in a capital expenditures-to-revenue ratio of approximately 5.11%. Furthermore, as of December 31, 2022, net property, plant, and equipment stood at $9,178 million. While 3M maintains significant global manufacturing operations and invests heavily in physical facilities and equipment to drive organic growth, these metrics reflect a standard industrial manufacturing profile rather than extreme capital intensity.
rationale: The answer cites exact figures for capital expenditures ($1,749 million), revenue ($34,229 million), and net property, plant, and equipment ($9,178 million) from 3M's FY2022 10-K, without including any uncited percentage calculations.
